components.notes: Definition supplies sample space, i.i.d. product laws over classes, randomized tests, A/B worst-case errors, level problem, max-loss and weighted-risk problems incl. prior-weight case (Huber problems (i)-(iii), source p.1754). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.notes: Contamination classes, a_i, sup-event d_TV and ||.||_var=2 d_TV, equal-radius variation classes with delta=eps/2; matches source Sec.7 convention via eq.(7) mass eps/2 (source p.1758). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Overlap and the exact loss of uniform discrimination
components.notes: Annex proves variation identity, domination characterization of contamination members, m<=1 necessity/sufficiency (explicit common member), equal-fraction threshold m=(1-e)(1+d), TV intersection iff eps>=d, and the three constant-test optima with lower bounds. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The original normalization equations and clipped pair
components.notes: Annex proves F,G continuity/monotonicity/uniqueness (source Lemma 1), membership, u<1/b and v<b via a_1F(1/b)=m>1, ratio branches incl. one-sided supports and null set, and recovers source equations (3) explicitly; one-zero-fraction endpoint cases stated in body. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

Annex proves g continuity/strict increase (source Lemma 3), 0<k_-<1/2<k_+<1, normalization, variation norm eps, clipped ratio branches reproducing source eq.(6)/(7); radius-zero and overlap boundaries handled. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Huber's order for every allowed contamination
components.notes: Annex proves outer inequalities for arbitrary (incl. singular) contaminants in both neighborhood types and the middle inequality from density likelihood order, plus weak-threshold limits (source Lemma 2 and its Sec.7 variant). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: A complete real-score coupling and product transfer
components.notes: Annex constructs quantile coupling on the real score space, independence across coordinates, well-definedness of products in each endpoint case, and the monotone-test attained sup/inf identities. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

Annex proves level-alpha NP optimality transfer incl. level 0 and 1, weighted pointwise minimization with zero-weight cases, and equalizer existence including perfect-discrimination threshold; zero-radius and 0*infinity tuple convention stated in body. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Larger neighborhoods and the source's sign-statistic limit
components.notes: Annex proves pointwise-extrema formulas, nesting of both neighborhood types, monotonicity of optimal power, monotonicity of c',c'', limits c'->1, c''->1 and the sign-count limit with the a.s. qualification (source Sec.4 remark). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

Annex verifies every finite number (19/54, Q_0,Q_1, 10/19, 27/95, 19/100, table rows, 71/114, 8991/19000), general-e formula and threshold 1/3, TV pair and 1/4 power, and normal example D, eps_N separation and 1-Phi(1)/D. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.
Annex computes 2e(1-e) vs 0, shows the classes differ in both directions, and the repeated-draw 19/100 counterexample. Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

Annex proves lower-set stochastic monotonicity from MLR (Tonelli), constructs measurable monotone extension r_* across support gaps, and proves the union-class order for contamination and variation; sequential transfer noted (source Sec.6 and Sec.7 last paragraph). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: Sequential errors and finite expected termination
components.notes: Annex proves eta<1, the moment bounds under every neighborhood law, geometric tails, finite EN, and the exit-error comparisons by pathwise coupling (source Sec.5). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.

components.description: The expected-size asymptotic under bounded clipping
components.notes: Annex proves uniform exit-probability bounds via stopped supermartingale with Fatou, the stopped-sum identity with integrability, uniform relative-error bounds without relative growth restriction, and both sup ratios ->1 (source Sec.5 expected-size result). Entry text matches the registered exact_current_text.
